info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Rides Route API provides access to detailed information on available rideshare routes. By utilizing this endpoint, clients can retrieve a list of routes for rideshare services, which is essential for optimizing travel plans and improving user experience. Typical consumers include app developers, transportation service providers, and logistics companies looking to integrate rideshare data into their solutions. This API enables enhanced trip planning and resource allocation in the dynamic rideshare market.

get.description: This operation allows you to retrieve the optimal route for a specified ride. It takes into consideration various parameters to provide the most efficient path. Ideal for planning your journey and ensuring a smooth ride experience.
